integrity: Analytical proof with exact monomial and Fourier identities; executable finite checks are corroborative only. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous symbols on the closed unit disk and the specified monomial slant map. Claim is an operator essential norm, not an essential spectrum statement; quantitative independence from older 1996 slant literature remains to be checked.
title: Exact antipodal boundary formula for the essential norm of Bergman slant Toeplitz operators
